messages.text: Your cookware set is still marked as shipped, so it isn’t eligible for a refund through this process yet; only delivered orders qualify (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). If you decide to return it, the shop must receive it first (refund-policy/v2/return). Cancelling an order or changing its delivery is outside this process. Would you like a staff member to help with that?
